name: Sentura MCP Health
description: MCP server health monitoring — periodically pings configured MCP servers, tracks connection status / errors / latency, exposes the live snapshot via gateway RPC and an agent-callable tool, and emits audit events on every status change.

checkIntervalMs.description: How often to ping each configured MCP server (milliseconds).

checkTimeoutMs.description: Per-server check timeout. Servers that don't reply within this window are flagged as 'down'.

degradedAfterErrors.description: After this many consecutive failed checks, the status is reported as 'degraded' before fully transitioning to 'down'.

downAfterErrors.description: After this many consecutive failed checks, the status is reported as 'down'.

emitAuditOnEveryCheck.description: When true, every health check (not just transitions) emits a `mcp_health_check` audit event. Default false to keep audit volume manageable.

stateFile.description: Path to the health snapshot JSON file. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/sentura-mcp-health/health.json.
